<?php
interface I145Root { public function value(): int; }
interface I145Read extends I145Root {}
interface I145Name { public function name(): string; }
function make145Multi() { return new class implements I145Read, I145Name {
    public int $n = 4;
    public function value(): int { return $this->n; }
    public function name(): string { return 'N'; }
}; }
function accept145Multi(I145Root $value) { return $value->value(); }
$a = make145Multi(); $b = make145Multi();
echo $a instanceof I145Root ? 'root|' : 'bad|';
echo $a instanceof I145Read ? 'read|' : 'bad|';
echo $a instanceof I145Name ? 'name|' : 'bad|';
echo $a !== $b ? 'fresh|' : 'bad|';
echo $a::class === $b::class ? 'same|' : 'bad|';
$r =& $a->n; $r = '7';
echo accept145Multi($a), '/', $b->value(), '|', $a->name(), '|', $a::class;

<?php
interface I145ReadBase { public function read(): int; }
interface I145LabelBase { public function label(): string; }
interface I145CtorBase { public function __construct(int $value); }
class Base145Methods {
    public int $value = 2;
    public function __construct(int $value) { $this->value = $value; }
    public function read(): int { return $this->value; }
}
$o = new class(value: '5') extends Base145Methods implements I145ReadBase, I145LabelBase, I145CtorBase {
    public function label(): string { return 'L'; }
};
echo $o instanceof Base145Methods ? 'base|' : 'bad|';
echo $o instanceof I145ReadBase ? 'read|' : 'bad|';
echo $o instanceof I145LabelBase ? 'label|' : 'bad|';
echo $o instanceof I145CtorBase ? 'ctor|' : 'bad|';
echo $o->read(), '|', $o->label(), '|', $o::class;

<?php
interface I145Retry { public function value(): int; }
$fail145 = true;
function argument145Retry() {
    global $fail145;
    if ($fail145) { $fail145 = false; throw new Exception('stop'); }
    return 3;
}
function make145Retry() { return new class(argument145Retry()) implements I145Retry {
    public int $n;
    public function __construct(int $n) { $this->n = $n; }
    public function value(): int { return $this->n; }
}; }
try { make145Retry(); } catch (Exception $e) { echo 'stop|'; }
$a = make145Retry(); $b = make145Retry();
echo $a !== $b ? 'fresh|' : 'bad|';
echo $a::class === $b::class ? 'same|' : 'bad|';
echo $a->value(), '/', $b->value(), '|', $a::class;

<?php
interface I145Read { public function value(): int; }
interface I145Tag {}
function make145Inner() {
    return new class implements I145Read, I145Tag {
        public int $number = 7;
        public function value(): int { return $this->number; }
    };
}
class Base145Cause {
    public function __construct() { global $inner145; $inner145 = make145Inner(); }
    public function value(): int { return 3; }
}
function read145(I145Read $o): int { return $o->value(); }
$outer145 = new class extends Base145Cause implements I145Tag, I145Read {};
echo $inner145::class, '|', $outer145::class, '|';
echo $inner145 instanceof I145Read && $inner145 instanceof I145Tag ? 'inner|' : 'bad|';
echo $outer145 instanceof I145Read && $outer145 instanceof I145Tag ? 'outer|' : 'bad|';
echo read145($inner145), '/', read145($outer145), '|';
$alias145 =& $inner145->number;
$alias145 = '9';
echo $inner145->number === 9 ? 'int9|' : 'bad|';
$again145 = make145Inner();
echo $again145 !== $inner145 && $again145::class === $inner145::class ? 'fresh/same' : 'bad';
